management-governance.purpose: Organizations, SCPs, Identity Center, Security Hub, GuardDuty, Config aggregation, OAM, organization CloudTrail, invocation-log archive, CUR and immutable compliance evidence.

org_admin.purpose: Attach and detach service control policies and manage OUs.

audit_reader.purpose: Read the organization trail, invocation-log archive and compliance evidence to corroborate every adversarial case.

evidence_archive_writer.purpose: Write sanitized evidence bundles into the retained archive.

unprivileged_probe.purpose: Deliberately low-privilege attacker identity for negative cases in this account.

platform.purpose: AgentCore Registry, the central AgentCore Inference Gateway, inference targets, native rate limits, platform identity, pipelines and the three sanctioned control-plane surfaces.

platform_admin.purpose: Own the inference Gateway, guardrails and rate-limit profiles.

inference_gateway_invoker.purpose: Cross-account role a workstream runtime assumes to reach the central inference Gateway.

registry_admin.purpose: Sole writer of the AgentCore Registry. Submits registration requests but must not approve its own.

registry_approver.purpose: Approves AgentCore Registry registration requests. Separation of duties: the submitter must not also approve.

unprivileged_probe.purpose: Deliberately low-privilege attacker identity for negative cases in this account.

workstream.purpose: AgentCore Runtime, the per-workstream Tool Gateway, Memory, application data and per-agent operations.

workstream_admin.purpose: Workstream owner identity. Must not be able to mutate platform-owned resources or deploy out of band.

agent_runtime.purpose: AgentCore Runtime execution role. Reaches models only through the Gateway and tools only through MCPClient.

tool_gateway_invoker.purpose: Calls the per-workstream Tool Gateway over MCP.

memory_client.purpose: Reads and writes AgentCore Memory within a static namespace template.

cicd_deploy.purpose: The only identity permitted to change workstream infrastructure, and only from the workload pipeline.

developer_readonly.purpose: Human developer access. Read-only by construction; used as the attacker for every no-fast-path case.

unprivileged_probe.purpose: Deliberately low-privilege attacker identity for negative cases in this account.
